import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_power_period_characterization {a n t : ℕ} (ha : a > 1) (ht : 0 < t) (htn : t ≤ n) : Nat.ModEq (a ^ n - 1) (a ^ t) 1 ↔ t = n := by
  have hpow2 : ∀ k : ℕ, 0 < k → 2 ≤ a ^ k := by
    intro k hk
    cases k with
    | zero =>
        omega
    | succ k =>
        rw [pow_succ]
        have hpk : 0 < a ^ k := Nat.pow_pos (by omega)
        have hpk' : 1 ≤ a ^ k := by omega
        simpa using (Nat.mul_le_mul hpk' ha)
  
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : t < n := by omega
    have hd : 0 < n - t := by omega
  
    have hfactor : a ^ n = a ^ t * a ^ (n - t) := by
      calc
        a ^ n = a ^ (t + (n - t)) := by
          rw [Nat.add_sub_of_le htn]
        _ = a ^ t * a ^ (n - t) := by
          rw [pow_add]
  
    have hpt : 2 ≤ a ^ t := hpow2 t ht
    have hpd : 2 ≤ a ^ (n - t) := hpow2 (n - t) hd
  
    have hmul : a ^ t * 2 ≤ a ^ t * a ^ (n - t) :=
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left (a ^ t) hpd
  
    have hgap : a ^ t + 2 ≤ a ^ t * a ^ (n - t) := by
      nlinarith [hmul, hpt]
  
    have hmod : a ^ t < a ^ n - 1 := by
      rw [hfactor]
      omega
  
    have hmone : 1 < a ^ n - 1 := by
      omega
  
    change a ^ t % (a ^ n - 1) = 1 % (a ^ n - 1) at h
    rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hmod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hmone] at h
  
    have hpow_one : a ^ t = 1 := h
    omega
  
  · intro h
    subst t
    have hnpos : 0 < n := by omega
    have hpn : 2 ≤ a ^ n := hpow2 n hnpos
    have hx : a ^ n = (a ^ n - 1) + 1 := by omega
  
    change a ^ n % (a ^ n - 1) = 1 % (a ^ n - 1)
    rw [hx, Nat.add_mod]
    simp

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Fintype Set Real Ideal Polynomial
open scoped BigOperators

theorem bounded_power_period_characterization {a n t : ℕ} (ha : a > 1) (ht : 0 < t) (htn : t ≤ n) : Nat.ModEq (a ^ n - 1) (a ^ t) 1 ↔ t = n := by
  have hn : 0 < n := lt_of_lt_of_le ht htn
  have hge : 1 ≤ a ^ n := Nat.one_le_pow n a (by omega)
  have hpowgt : 1 < a ^ n :=
    Nat.one_lt_pow (n := n) (a := a) (by omega) ha
  
  have hbase : Nat.ModEq (a ^ n - 1) (a ^ n) 1 := by
    change a ^ n % (a ^ n - 1) = 1 % (a ^ n - 1)
    by_cases hm : a ^ n - 1 = 1
    · rw [hm]
      have hmod : a ^ n % 1 < 1 := Nat.mod_lt _ (by omega)
      omega
    · have hmgt : 1 < a ^ n - 1 := by omega
      have hone : 1 % (a ^ n - 1) = 1 :=
        Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)
      calc
        a ^ n % (a ^ n - 1) =
            (a ^ n - 1 + 1) % (a ^ n - 1) := by
              rw [Nat.sub_add_cancel hge]
        _ = 1 % (a ^ n - 1) := by
              rw [Nat.add_mod]
              simp [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hmgt, hone]
  
  constructor
  · intro hcong
    by_contra hne
    have hlt : t < n := by omega
    have hpowlt : a ^ t < a ^ n :=
      Nat.pow_lt_pow_right (by omega) hlt
    have ht1 : t + 1 ≤ n := by omega
    have hpowle : a ^ (t + 1) ≤ a ^ n :=
      Nat.pow_le_pow_right (by omega) ht1
    have htpowgt : 1 < a ^ t :=
      Nat.one_lt_pow (n := t) (a := a) (by omega) ha
    have htwo : 2 ≤ a ^ t := by omega
    have hmul : a ^ t * 2 ≤ a ^ t * a := by
      exact Nat.mul_le_mul_left (a ^ t) (by omega)
    have hdouble : a ^ t + 2 ≤ a ^ t * 2 := by omega
    have hstep2 : a ^ t + 2 ≤ a ^ (t + 1) := by
      rw [pow_succ]
      exact le_trans hdouble hmul
    have hmodulus : a ^ t + 1 ≤ a ^ n - 1 := by
      have : a ^ t + 2 ≤ a ^ n := le_trans hstep2 hpowle
      omega
    have hmod : a ^ t < a ^ n - 1 := by omega
    have hgt : 1 < a ^ n - 1 := by
      have : 1 ≤ a ^ t := Nat.one_le_pow t a (by omega)
      omega
    have heq : a ^ t = 1 := by
      change a ^ t % (a ^ n - 1) = 1 % (a ^ n - 1) at hcong
      rw [Nat.mod_eq_of_lt hmod, Nat.mod_eq_of_lt (by omega)] at hcong
      exact hcong
    omega
  · intro h
    subst t
    exact hbase
